_comment: All child-facing text. To add a language, copy this file, translate the values (keep the {placeholders}) and load it instead. Lines given as lists are picked at random.
_voiceFilesComment: Map a line id to a recorded clip, e.g. "tutorial-0": "assets/audio/voice/en/tutorial-0.mp3". Lines without a recording use the device's built-in English voice.

splash.title: Mystery Island
splash.tagline: Explore islands, solve puzzles and find the lost treasure!

profiles.title: Who is exploring today?
profiles.subtitle: Tap your explorer to continue your adventure.
profiles.limitBody: This device can keep {max} explorers. A grown-up can remove one in the Parent Area to make room.

setup.nickHelp: Use a fun nickname, not your real full name.
setup.nickNeeded: Type or pick a nickname first.

setup.bandDesc1: Times tables, spelling and trickier patterns
setup.bandDesc2: Word problems, big logic and map skills

world.lockedBody: Finish the level before this one to open it.

level.clueLabel: Glowing clue: tap to start the challenge
level.leaveBody: You can come back any time. Your stars and coins are safe.
level.resumeBody: Do you want to carry on from challenge {n}?

reward.title: Level complete!

ending.title: You found the treasure!
ending.body: The greatest treasure is everything you learned on the way. Keep exploring: replay levels to earn more stars, and decorate your Camp!

camp.title: Explorer Camp
camp.needMore: You need more {currency}. Play levels to earn them!
camp.note: Coins and gems are earned by playing. They are just for fun and can't be bought.

parent.title: Parent Area
parent.gateIntro: This area is for grown-ups. Press and hold the button.
parent.gateWrong: That's not right. Please try again.
parent.intro: Everything below is stored only on this device. Nothing is sent to a server.
parent.resetOneBody: This deletes this explorer's progress, rewards and Camp items from this device. It cannot be undone.
parent.analyticsOn: When on, the game sends anonymous counts (like 'a level was completed') to this website's own statistics. No names, nicknames, cookies or device IDs are ever sent.
parent.analyticsNotSetUp: Usage counting is not set up on this website, so nothing is sent either way.
parent.privacyNote: The game has no ads, no chat, no accounts and no links to other websites. Explorers store only a nickname, an age group and an avatar.
parent.mode_memory: nowhere: this browser is blocking storage, so progress will be lost when the page closes
parent.resetAllBody: Delete every explorer, all progress and all settings on this device.
parent.resetAllConfirm: This deletes ALL explorers and their progress from this device.
parent.resetAllSure: Are you completely sure? This cannot be undone.

errors.notSaved: Your progress could not be saved on this device. A grown-up can check the browser's storage settings.
errors.noStorage: This browser is blocking storage, so progress can't be saved after you close the page.
errors.levelBroken: Oops, this level couldn't start. Please try another level.
errors.corruptTitle: Some saved data couldn't be read
errors.corruptBody: Part of the saved game on this device looks damaged. A grown-up can fix this in the Parent Area by removing an explorer or resetting all data.

tutorial: Squawk! Hello {name}! I'm Kiki, your parrot guide. Welcome to Mystery Island!
An old treasure map was torn into pieces. Each island hides one piece. Tap an island on the map to explore it.
Every island has puzzles. If you get stuck, tap the hint button. Mistakes are okay, just try again!
Solve puzzles to earn stars and coins. Spend coins at your Camp on hats, pets and more!
Our adventure starts at Pirate Beach. Ready, explorer?
kiki.mapFirst: Hi {name}! Let's start at Pirate Beach. Tap Go!
kiki.allDone: Wow, {name}! You finished every level! Replay levels to win more stars.
kiki.worldLocked: This island is still locked. Finish all 10 levels of {prev} first!
kiki.worldLockedFinal: Treasure Island needs all four map pieces. You need {n} more!

kiki.worldDone: You finished {world}! Replay any level to earn more stars.
explore: Look around! Tap the glowing {clue} to find the challenge.
reward1: You did it! Play again to win more stars.
kiki.rewardImproved: You beat your best score! More stars for you!
kiki.camp: This is your Camp! Earn coins by playing, then get hats, outfits, pets and decorations.
kiki.ending: You did it, {name}! The treasure chest is open. You're a true Master Explorer!
